info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Session Handoff-spec
info.description: The Session Handoff Management API enables seamless transfer of session ownership between users in banking applications. By leveraging this API, developers can facilitate the `handoff` process for existing sessions identified by a unique `sessionId`. This is particularly useful for use cases such as customer support transitions, where one representative might need to hand off a customer session to another. Typical consumers of this API include customer service platforms and banking applications aiming to enhance user experience.

post.summary: Create a handoff for a specific session.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a handoff for the specified session resource, facilitating the transfer of responsibilities or information between parties involved in the session.

requestBody.description: The request body for initiating a handoff operation in the session identified by RES-100045. This body must conform to the specified JSON schema to ensure proper execution of the handoff process.
